source.instruction_summary: Resume Story 18.4 through normal governed delivery to completion, lifting the earlier plan-only and merge-only restrictions while retaining every review, approval and verification gate.

purposes: planned-change authorization after current independent plan ACCEPT when required
implementation approval after current complete-definition ACCEPT
finite recovery extension at a reached pause limit
delegation.max_pause_at_semantics: Cumulative per unresolved episode; every reached limit requires a fresh decision and the ceiling grants no automatic attempts.

preserved_gates_and_limits: This instruction is not advance approval of the revised plan.
Independent plan review, applicable planned-change authorization, task generation, complete-definition review and implementation approval remain ordered gates.
Recovery count, holds, diagnosis requirements, model strategy and historical evidence remain unchanged.
No access, database, credential, spend, production, destructive-operation or verification-waiver authority is granted.
Owned database, migration and runtime qualification require separately explicit authorized resources.
No main merge, push, history rewrite or another story is authorized.
